messages: Alex Chen: Heads up — noticed create dataset modal defaults Region to 'us-west' when the org profile is EU-only. That can lead to accidental cross-region writes and compliance flags. We should default to org preference or surface a clear enforcement notice. Maria Gomez: Agree. Right now the dropdown is small and easy to miss. Suggest making the default explicit in the label: 'Region (default: EU — set by org policy)'. Also add a visible lock badge when it's enforced. Jin Park: UX/accessibility nit: the encryption toggle label currently reads 'Enable KMS' and SRs announce 'checkbox'. We should use a more descriptive label + proper aria attributes. Also wondering if region should be radio buttons when org has only one allowed region — fewer surprises. Sam Fisher: Copy thought: change 'Enable KMS' -> 'Use customer-managed keys (KMS)'. It's longer but clearer in audit entries. Also prefer past simple tense in logs e.g. 'Customer-managed keys enabled'. DesignBot: Mock snippet for aria/connectivity: ```html Keys are stored in your KMS. Audit logs will reference key ID. ``` Small note: use role="switch" for toggles to improve SR announcement. Alex Chen: Love the snippet. Jin, can you also add aria-describedby to the region notice and make the enforcement badge focusable for keyboard users? Jin Park: Will do. Also filing an a11y PR: the region dropdown focus ring is too faint in high-contrast modes. Outline color doesn't meet WCAG 2.1 AA for 3:1 on focused control. PR includes new outline color + token. Maria Gomez: For audit log copy, Sam — prefer concise past tense: 'Customer-managed keys enabled by Maria Gomez (key-id: xyz)'. Keep event subject, action, and key/context. Sam Fisher: Sounds good. I'll standardize events to: [actor] [action] [object] (context). Example: 'Sam Fisher enabled customer-managed keys (key-id: xyz)'. Also add previous state where applicable. Alex Chen: Another UX nit: the retention input is labeled just 'Retention' — ambiguous. Suggest 'Data retention period (days)' or a segmented dropdown with presets: 30 / 90 / 365 / Custom. Jin Park: +1. For the numeric input we should support arrow key increments and announce unit with aria-live when changed. Quick ref: https://redwood.internal/a11y/inputs Maria Gomez: Can we add a small lock badge next to Region when it's org-enforced? Tooltip: 'Set by organization policy — cannot change'. Make sure tooltip is accessible (role="tooltip" and aria-describedby linking). Sam Fisher: :thumbsup: If we agree on the copy and a11y bits, I'll bundle into a single PR and coordinate with infra to add key-id to audit schema. Alex Chen: Sounds good — Jin please attach the mock and PR link by EOD so we can ship the a11y fixes in the next sprint. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
